name: La Horcajada (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Horcajada (a chequy field and a hermitage above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 25 January 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 110 of 7 June 2001); the flag is square of proportion 1:1, a yellow cloth with the arms of the town over all.

features.role: La Horcajada arms — chequy and hermitage above waves
